Overview

Mesa is a city in AZ with a population of 508,918. Phoenix suburb with affordable housing, spring training baseball, and desert recreation. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 301 sunny days a year.
